headline: Base Lines Shift on Three Contested Fronts
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the ledger shows continued movement on the principal contested fronts, though the guns have slackened in several sectors. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest field, recording 53 base events in 24 hours and one in the latest two-hour watch; its line now stands at three Warden, three Colonial, and three neutral bases, against the former two, two, and five. Linn Mercy has three recent events and 33 in the day, with holdings at three Warden, seven Colonial, and one neutral base; its two-hour casualty rates are rising despite a cooler latest hour. Nevish Line reports two events in two hours and 29 in 24, now divided among three Warden, four Colonial, and one neutral base. Mooring County’s activity has eased to 20 events, but all twelve bases are presently Warden-held. Stonecradle retains one Warden and eight Colonial bases after eight events in six hours, while Marban Hollow is quiet in the latest watch and remains divided at four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral. Many other sectors show no base events and only light activity.
